chunks.subject: AP Statistics
chunks.title: Q3 — Probability and Sampling Distributions (4 points)
chunks.content: AP Statistics FRQ 3 focuses on Probability and Sampling Distributions, 4 points. Each lettered part is scored E/P/I and combined into an integer 0–4. Typical tasks: compute a probability (using the correct model — binomial, normal, or a two-way table), describe or use a sampling distribution (mean, standard deviation, shape via CLT), and interpret a probability in context. Common failure: wrong probability model or parameters; not checking conditions for a normal approximation; computing a probability without showing the setup; interpretation without context.

chunks.subject: AP Statistics
chunks.title: Q3 exemplar — Sample 3A, 4/4
chunks.content: Q3 scored 4/4 — all parts essentially correct: correct probability model and computation with setup, correct sampling-distribution parameters/shape, and a contextual interpretation. Full-credit model.

chunks.content: Q3 scored 2/4 — some parts partial: a probability computed with a setup error or without justifying the model, or a sampling-distribution description missing shape/conditions. Illustrates partial command of the probability tasks.

chunks.content: Q3 scored 1/4 — mostly incorrect: wrong probability model/parameters and no valid sampling-distribution reasoning. Illustrates a response that cannot set up the probability correctly.
